info.title: Ogami API
info.description: JSON API of the Ogami solo tabletop RPG companion.

post.summary: Sign in and start a session

200.description: Signed in; the response sets the HttpOnly session cookie.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or misses a field.

429.description: Too many failed attempts; try again later.

post.summary: End the session

204.description: Signed out (also when there was no session).

200.description: The signed-in user.

post.summary: Add a Character to one of my campaigns

201.description: The new Character, its values complete: a field not given has its default.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed, has no string "name", or a field of another JSON type than documented.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id.

409.description: The campaign already holds 100 Characters, or another request changed it meanwhile.

422.description: A value breaks a rule (blank or too long name, too many or repeated Tags or free tags, "values" not an object, an unknown sheet field, a value of the wrong type or out of its bounds) or a Tag is not in the pinned release.

put.summary: Replace the name, Tags, free tags and values of a Character of one of my campaigns

200.description: The edited Character; a value not given went back to its default, the NPC it was promoted from stays.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed, has no string "name", or a field of another JSON type than documented.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or it holds no Character with this id.

409.description: Another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

422.description: A value breaks a rule (blank or too long name, too many or repeated Tags or free tags, "values" not an object, an unknown sheet field, a value of the wrong type or out of its bounds) or a Tag is not in the pinned release.

200.description: The signed-in player's campaigns, newest first.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

post.summary: Create a campaign pinned to the latest release of a GameSystem

201.description: The new campaign; the Location header is its URL.

Location.description: The URL of the new campaign.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed, has no string "name" or "gameSystemKey", or a "flowKey" that is not a string.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: The GameSystem has no published release, or its latest release has no Flow with this key.

409.description: The generated campaign id is already taken.

422.description: The name is blank or too long, or Play cannot read the latest release of the GameSystem yet.

200.description: The campaign.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id.

post.summary: Start the next session of one of my campaigns

201.description: The campaign, the new session current and without a scene.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id.

409.description: The campaign already holds the most sessions it can, or another request changed it meanwhile.

post.summary: End the current session of one of my campaigns

200.description: The ended session. No scene starts until the next session. While guided, a session with a session closing stays under way (no end time) until its "Session N ends" hook Scene finishes.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id.

409.description: No session is under way (none has started, or it has ended); while guided, the FlowRun is in a scene or a hook (a guided session ends at the scene pick), or the session closing does not fit the session; or another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

post.summary: Start the next scene in the current session of one of my campaigns

201.description: The campaign, the new scene current.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed: neither a string "title" nor a string "sceneType", or one of them is not a string.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or its pinned release has no Scene Type with this key.

409.description: No session is under way (none has started, or it has ended), the current session holds the most scenes it can, or another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

422.description: The title is blank or too long.

post.summary: Switch the Scene Type of the current scene of one of my campaigns by hand

200.description: The current scene with its new Scene Type; its number, title and journal entries stay.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or has no string "sceneType".

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or its pinned release has no Scene Type with this key.

409.description: The campaign has no current scene, the current scene is a hook Scene, or another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

put.summary: Replace the cast of the current scene of one of my campaigns

200.description: The current scene with its new cast; its number, title and journal entries stay.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed, or "npcIds" or "characterIds" is not a list of strings.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or an id is not an NPC (or, in "characterIds", a Character) of the campaign (a blank or malformed one included).

409.description: The campaign has no current scene, or another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

422.description: An NPC or a Character is listed twice.

put.summary: Replace the party of the current session of one of my campaigns

200.description: The current session with its new party; its scenes keep the Characters they have.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or "characterIds" is not a list of strings.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or an id is not a Character of the campaign (a blank or malformed one included).

409.description: No session is under way (none has started, or it has ended), or another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

422.description: A Character is listed twice.

put.summary: Set the value of a Tracker of one of my campaigns by hand

200.description: The Tracker with the value kept, clamped to its range.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or has no integer "value".

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or its pinned release has no Tracker with this key.

409.description: Another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

post.summary: Add a free fact to one of my campaigns

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or a link names an NPC, Thread or fact it does not hold.

409.description: The campaign already holds 500 facts, or another request changed it meanwhile.

422.description: A value breaks a rule (blank or too long label or text, more than 20 links, a link repeated).

put.summary: Edit a fact of one of my campaigns: a free fact's label and text, and any fact's links

200.description: The edited fact.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, it holds no fact with this id, or a link names an NPC, Thread or fact it does not hold.

409.description: Another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

422.description: A value breaks a rule (blank or too long label or text, more than 20 links, a link repeated, a link to the fact itself), a free fact lacks its label or text, or a slot fact is given a label or text.

200.description: The slot fact, newly created or refilled.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed, or a field is of another JSON type than documented (a subject that is not a UUID).

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or the subject is an NPC or Thread it does not hold.

409.description: The campaign already holds 500 facts, NPCs or Threads and the fill would add one, or another request changed it meanwhile.

422.description: The release declares no slot with this key, not exactly one of text, subject and name is sent, the value does not fit the slot's type (a text on an NPC or Thread slot, a subject or name on a text slot), or it breaks a rule (blank or too long text or name).

post.summary: Complete the current step of the FlowRun of one of my campaigns and record its result in the journal

200.description: The campaign, with its FlowRun moved on.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed: no string "stepKey", or a non-string "text", "optionKey" or "likelihood", a non-integer "chaosFactor", or "pickedIds" that is not a list of strings.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or its pinned release has no oracle (or not the Tracker its chaos is bound to) with the key of the step.

409.description: The campaign plays freely, guidance is paused or the Flow is complete, the FlowRun waits for another step, the next scene does not fit the session (200 scenes), an NPC, Thread or slot fact the step creates would take an id the campaign already holds, or another request changed the campaign meanwhile (or took the generated entry id).

422.description: A field does not belong to the step's kind or a required one is missing, the text is blank or too long, the option or likelihood level is unknown, the chaos factor is out of range or not expected (also when the oracle takes it from a campaign Tracker), a picked id is no candidate, repeats, or the count picked is outside the step's minimum and maximum, or "pickedIds" is sent for a step that takes none (or missing in mode choose), or the step is a condition step.

post.summary: Ask a likelihood oracle of the pinned release and record the answer in the current scene of one of my campaigns

400.description: The JSON body is malformed: no string "likelihood", a non-integer "chaosFactor" or a non-string "question".

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or its pinned release has no likelihood oracle with this key (or not the Tracker its chaos is bound to).

post.summary: Ask a likelihood oracle a yes/no question

200.description: The answer, the roll and the effective target it was compared with.

422.description: The oracle is invalid, it has no such likelihood level, or the chaos factor is out of range or given without chaos.

post.summary: Roll on an oracle table, following nested tables

200.description: Every table rolled on, root first, with the dice, total and selected entry.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed, or has no "tables" list (a JSON object is not one) or no string "table".

422.description: The tables are invalid, none has the key asked, or a roll matches no entry.

post.summary: Roll a dice expression

200.description: The roll: its total and every die rolled, dropped ones included.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or has no string "expression".

422.description: The expression is not valid dice notation, exceeds a limit or divides by zero.

get.summary: Report whether the API and its database are up

200.description: The API is up; the database status is reported separately.

error.description: A human-readable message; never says whether an email exists.

tags.description: Keys of Tags of the campaign's pinned release, at most 10, each once; none when omitted or null.

freeTags.description: The player's own labels, at most 10 of 1 to 50 characters, unique ignoring case; none when omitted or null.

values.description: The values of the pinned release's sheet fields: field key to value. A number field takes an integer, a text field a string, a list field an array of strings and a track field {current, max} (max is fixed by the field when it sets one, else required). A field not given takes its default (a number its default or 0, a text "", a list [], a track full). An unknown key, a value of the wrong type or out of its bounds is refused.

tags.description: The keys of the pinned release's Tags the Character carries.

freeTags.description: The player's own labels, as typed.

values.description: One value per field of the pinned release's sheet, in field order, named by the field key: an integer (number), a string (text), an array of strings (list) or {current, max} (track). Empty when the release has no sheet.

promotedFrom.description: The id of the NPC this Character was promoted from; null when it was created as a Character.

releaseVersion.description: The release version the campaign is pinned to.

gameSystemKey.description: A GameSystem from `GET /api/play/game-systems`; the campaign is pinned to its latest release.

flowKey.description: A Flow of that release to play along; absent or null to play freely (the release's default Flow is not applied).

notice.description: The text to show, such as a publisher disclaimer.
notice.example: Night Job is unofficial content provided under the Homebrew Content Policy of R. Talsorian Games.

license.description: The name of the license or policy; null when the release names none.
license.example: R. Talsorian Games Homebrew Content Policy

url.description: An absolute https:// URL of the license or policy; null when the release gives none.

key.description: The key Character values are stored under.

hint.description: Help shown with the field; null when there is none.

group.description: Consecutive fields with the same group are laid out together; null when ungrouped.

type.description: A number is an integer, a text a string, a list an array of strings and a track {current, max}.

min.description: Number: the lowest value (-1000000 when the field sets none). Null for other types.

max.description: Number: the highest value (1000000 when the field sets none). Track: the fixed max; null when each Character sets its own. Null for other types.

default.description: Number: the value of a Character that has none. Null for other types.

multiline.description: Text: whether it may span lines. Null for other types.

maxLength.description: Text: the most characters (200, or 2000 when multiline, unless the field sets one). Null for other types.

itemLabel.description: List: what one item is called, such as "Item". Null when none or for other types.

maxItems.description: List: the most items (50 unless the field sets one). Null for other types.

theme.description: The curated Theme the release asks for; null means the default app theme.

credits.description: The notice, license and link the release carries; null when it has none.

sheet.description: The fields of the release's character sheet in layout order; empty for a release without one. Characters hold a value per field.

id.description: The id of the NPC, Thread or Character.

kind.description: A scene of play, or a hook Scene.

sceneType.description: The key of the scene's Scene Type; null for a hook Scene or a scene without one.

sceneTypeName.description: The name of the scene's Scene Type in the pinned release.

hook.description: The hook a hook Scene records; null for a scene of play.

cast.description: The NPCs in the scene, in cast order, named as the campaign names them now; closed NPCs stay. Empty for a scene without a cast.

characters.description: The Characters in the scene, in cast order, named as the campaign names them now. A new scene starts with the session's party. Empty for a scene without Characters.

scenes.description: In number order; empty right after the session starts.

endedAt.description: When the session ended; null while it is under way.

party.description: The Characters playing, in the order they joined, named as the campaign names them now. The next session starts with the same party.

key.description: The likelihood to ask the oracle with.

chaos.description: Null when the oracle takes no chaos factor.

chaosTracker.description: The key of the campaign Tracker whose value is the chaos factor, so no chaos factor is sent; null when the player picks it.

upTo.description: The highest value of the level; null for the last level, which catches the rest.

min.description: The lowest value; 0 for a clock.

max.description: The highest value; the number of segments for a clock.

segments.description: The number of segments of a clock; null for a counter.

levels.description: The named ranges of a counter, in order; empty for a clock.

levelLabel.description: The label of the level the value falls in; null without levels.

act.description: The Act the phase belongs to; null when the Flow has none.

phaseKey.description: The key of the phase, which "Move on" names.

sceneType.description: The name of the Scene Type being played; null at the scene pick.

part.description: The part of the scene, or the hook running; null at the scene pick.

stepNumber.description: The number of the step, from 1; null when no step waits. Condition steps are not counted.

stepCount.description: The number of steps in the part; null when no step waits.

mode.description: Drawn by the server, or chosen by the player.

min.description: The fewest items to pick; with fewer candidates the step completes with nothing picked.

tags.description: The release Tags the items must carry, all of them; empty matches any open item.

candidates.description: The open items of the kind that carry all the Tags, in list order; empty when none match.

label.description: What players see for the slot.

type.description: What the slot takes: a text, an NPC or a Thread.

hint.description: Shown where the slot is filled; null when the slot has none.

kind.description: How the step is completed; a condition step never waits, so it is never the current one.

prompt.description: The text to read or answer.

tip.example: Think of a role: a netrunner, a fixer.

mandatory.description: A mandatory step cannot be skipped.

oracle.description: The key of the likelihood oracle asked (oracle step); null for the other kinds.

likelihood.description: The likelihood level the oracle step always asks at; null when the player picks it, and for the other kinds.

table.description: The key of the oracle table rolled (table step); null for the other kinds.

dice.description: The dice expression rolled (roll step); null for the other kinds.

options.description: The options to pick from (choice step); empty for the other kinds.

pick.description: What the step picks from (pick step); null for the other kinds.

fills.description: The Fact slots any Effect of the step may fill, in the release's slot order (a fillFact Effect fills a slot once the step is completed); empty for a step that fills none.

tips.description: Advice for playing the scene; null when the Scene Type has none.
tips.example: Ask what the contact wants before you ask for anything.

oracles.description: The keys of the oracles the Scene Type shortcuts, in shortcut order.

rule.description: How the Scene Type is chosen: the Flow's sequence, the player, or an oracle table.

cards.description: The Scene Types offered, in offer order; none when the table is to be rolled.

table.description: The key of the oracle table to roll for the Scene Type; null otherwise.

forced.description: Whether the only card is a Scene Type forced for the next scene.

status.description: Active guides play; paused, the player plays freely and resumes later; completed after the last phase.

waitsForSession.description: Whether no session is under way, so nothing can be played yet.

progress.description: Where the FlowRun stands; null once the Flow is complete.

step.description: The step the FlowRun waits on; null at the scene pick and in open play.

pick.description: The scene pick the FlowRun waits on; null in a scene or a hook.

canMoveOn.description: Whether "Move on" ends the phase now (a loop phase that is not ending yet, while guided).

next.description: The next step named, such as "Closing: What changed?" or "Flow complete".
next.example: Next scene: choose a scene type

canEndSession.description: Whether "End session" is offered between scenes: at the scene pick, guided, with a session under way. It runs the session closing first.

description.description: Null when the Flow has none.

introduction.description: Shown when the campaign starts; null when the Flow has none.

default.description: Whether this is the release's default Flow (at most one is).

defaultView.description: How a campaign playing it opens.

oracles.description: The keys of the oracles the Flow shows, in panel order.

trackers.description: The keys of the Trackers the Flow shows while it guides the campaign, in panel order.

label.description: What players see for the Tag.

hint.description: Shown as a tooltip where Tags are chosen; null when the Tag has none.
hint.example: Runs a faction or a crew.

agenda.description: What the NPC wants; null when none was written.

tags.description: The keys of the pinned release's Tags the NPC carries; flows pick and count by them.

freeTags.description: The player's own labels, as typed; flows never match them.

weight.description: Favours the NPC in a random pick: 1 to 3.

status.description: A closed NPC is no longer picked or counted.

promotedTo.description: The id of the Character this NPC was promoted to; null when it was not. A promoted NPC is closed for good.

tags.description: The keys of the pinned release's Tags the Thread carries; flows pick and count by them.

freeTags.description: The player's own labels, as typed; flows never match them.

weight.description: Favours the Thread in a random pick: 1 to 3.

status.description: A closed Thread is no longer picked or counted.

kind.description: A subject is always an NPC or a Thread.

name.description: The NPC's or Thread's name, or the linked fact's label.

slot.description: The key of the Fact slot the fact fills; null for a free fact.

label.description: The label the player wrote; for a slot fact, the slot's label.

text.description: The text of a free fact or of a "text" slot; null when the slot holds an NPC or a Thread.
text.example: Owes a debt to the Prince.

subject.description: The NPC or Thread an "npc" / "thread" slot holds; null otherwise.

value.description: What the fact says: its text, or its subject's name now.
value.example: Owes a debt to the Prince.

links.description: What the fact links to, in the order the player gave.

currentSessionNumber.description: The session under way: the latest one unless it has ended; null before the first one or once it ends.

currentSceneNumber.description: The latest scene of the current session; null when it has none yet.

oracleTables.description: The oracle tables of the pinned release, in definition order.

likelihoodOracles.description: The likelihood oracles of the pinned release, in definition order.

trackers.description: The Trackers of the pinned release with the campaign's values, in definition order; empty for schema version 1.

flowKey.description: The key of the Flow the campaign plays; null when played freely.

flowRun.description: The FlowRun guiding the campaign; null when played freely.

flows.description: The Flows of the pinned release, in definition order; empty for schema version 1.

sceneTypes.description: The Scene Types of the pinned release, in definition order; empty for schema version 1.

tags.description: The Tags of the pinned release, in definition order; empty for releases without any. NPCs and Threads carry them by key.

npcs.description: The campaign's NPCs: the open ones first, then the closed ones, each in creation order.

threads.description: The campaign's Threads: the open ones first, then the closed ones, each in creation order.

factSlots.description: The Fact slots of the pinned release, in definition order; empty for releases without any.

facts.description: The campaign's facts: the slot facts first, in slot order, then the free facts in creation order; empty for a campaign without any.

characters.description: The campaign's Characters in creation order; their values follow the pinned release's sheet.

StartSceneRequest.description: A title, a Scene Type, or both.

title.description: Trimmed; not blank. Optional with a Scene Type: the scene is then named after it, numbered per Scene Type in the campaign ("Legwork 2").

sceneType.description: The key of a Scene Type of the campaign's pinned release.
The key of a Scene Type of the campaign's pinned release.

npcIds.description: The whole new cast of the current scene, in cast order: NPCs of the campaign, closed ones allowed, none twice. An empty list empties the cast.

characterIds.description: The whole new Characters part of the cast, in order: Characters of the campaign, none twice. Absent or null keeps the Characters in the cast.
The whole new party of the session under way, in order: Characters of the campaign, none twice. An empty list empties the party. Scenes keep the Characters they have.

value.description: Clamped to the Tracker's range (min..max, 0..segments for a clock).

id.description: The id of the NPC, Thread or fact; it must be one the campaign holds.

text.example: Owes a debt to the Prince.

links.description: At most 20, each once; none when omitted or null.

label.description: Required for a free fact: 1 to 100 characters once trimmed. Refused for a slot fact.

text.description: Required for a free fact: 1 to 2000 characters once trimmed. Refused for a slot fact.
text.example: Owes a debt to the Prince.

links.description: Replace the fact's links with these: at most 20, each once; send an empty list to clear them.

text.description: For a "text" slot: 1 to 2000 characters once trimmed.

subject.description: For an "npc" or "thread" slot: the id of an NPC or Thread the campaign holds (closed ones too).

name.description: For an "npc" or "thread" slot: the name of a new open NPC or Thread (weight 1, no tags) to create and fill the slot with.

agenda.description: What the NPC wants, at most 2000 characters; none when omitted, null or blank.

tags.description: Keys of Tags of the campaign's pinned release, at most 10, each once; none when omitted or null.

freeTags.description: The player's own labels, at most 10 of 1 to 50 characters, unique ignoring case; none when omitted or null.

tags.description: Keys of Tags of the campaign's pinned release, at most 10, each once; none when omitted or null.

freeTags.description: The player's own labels, at most 10 of 1 to 50 characters, unique ignoring case; none when omitted or null.

stepKey.description: The step the player means to complete; refused when the FlowRun waits for another.

text.description: Prompt step: the answer, trimmed; not blank.

optionKey.description: Choice step: the key of the option chosen.

likelihood.description: Oracle step: the key of a likelihood level, only when the step does not fix one.

chaosFactor.description: Oracle step: within the oracle's chaos range; omitted or null for its neutral factor. Must be omitted or null when the oracle has no chaos or takes it from a campaign Tracker.

pickedIds.description: Pick step in mode choose: the ids of the candidates chosen, between the step's minimum and maximum, none twice; an empty list when nothing matches. Must be omitted or null in mode random.

stepKey.description: The step the player means to skip; refused when the FlowRun waits for another, or the step is mandatory.

sceneType.description: The key of one of the Scene Types the scene pick offers.

sceneNumber.description: The number of the guided scene in its session; refused when the FlowRun is not in open play in that scene.

phase.description: The key of the phase the FlowRun is in; refused when it is in another.

key.description: The key to create a campaign with.

description.description: Null when the Flow has none.

introduction.description: A longer text that orients a new player; null when the Flow has none.

default.description: Whether this is the release's default Flow (at most one is), to preselect.

gameSystemKey.description: The key to create a campaign with.

description.description: Null when the release has no description.

version.description: The version a new campaign is pinned to.

flows.description: The Flows a new campaign can play, in definition order; empty for schema version 1 (a campaign is always played freely then).

credits.description: The notice, license and link the release carries; null when it has none.

value.description: The face the die landed on.

kept.description: Whether the die counts towards the total; false when a selector dropped it.

dice.description: Every die rolled, in roll order, dropped ones included.

subtotal.description: The sum of the kept dice.

total.description: The value of the expression, counting kept dice only.

groups.description: Every dice group, in notation order; empty when the expression rolls no dice.

dice.description: The normalized notation rolled: the table's dice, or "1dW" for a weighted table of total weight W.

total.description: The total rolled, which selected the entry.

text.description: The selected entry's text; may be empty when the entry nests a table.

nestedTableKey.description: The table the next step rolls on; null on the last step.

sceneType.description: The key of the Scene Type the entry offers, which the player may switch the scene to; null when it offers none, and on rows recorded before the key was kept.

steps.description: Root table first, then each nested table rolled.

question.description: The question asked; null when none was given.

answer.description: Yes when the roll is at most the effective target, no otherwise; exceptional within the oracle's exceptional bands.

effectiveTarget.description: The level's target shifted by the chaos factor and clamped to 0…sides.

likelihood.description: The key of the likelihood level asked with.

chaosFactor.description: The chaos factor used (the neutral one when none was given); null when the oracle has no chaos.

randomEvent.description: The key of the oracle table to roll when the roll was a double whose digit is at most the chaos factor used and the oracle has a random event rule (one of the campaign's oracle tables); null otherwise.

optionKey.description: The key of the option chosen.

label.description: The label of the option chosen.

tags.description: The keys of the release Tags the step asked for, as they were stored; empty when it asked for none.

picked.description: The items picked, in the order picked, named as they were at pick time; empty when nothing matched.

flowStep.description: The Flow step that recorded the entry; null for an entry the player wrote or rolled by hand.

expression.description: Dice notation, rolled on the server (same grammar as `POST /api/rolls`).

likelihood.description: The key of one of the oracle's likelihood levels.

chaosFactor.description: Within the oracle's chaos range; omitted or null for its neutral factor. Must be omitted or null when the oracle has no chaos.

question.description: Trimmed; omitted, null or blank for no question.

target.description: The highest roll that answers yes at the neutral chaos factor; 0 to sides.

LikelihoodChaosDefinition.description: The effective target is the level's target + (chaosFactor − neutral) × shiftPerPoint, clamped to 0…sides; min ≤ neutral ≤ max.

neutral.description: The chaos factor used when none is given.

shiftPerPoint.description: Target points added per chaos point above neutral; 0 to sides.

LikelihoodRandomEventDefinition.description: A d100 roll that is a double (11, 22 … 99) whose digit is at most the chaos factor used triggers a random event on the table.

table.description: The key of the oracle table to roll for the event.

LikelihoodOracleDefinition.description: Rolls 1d<sides> = R against the effective target T: yes when R ≤ T. With p = exceptionalPercent, the yes is exceptional when R ≤ floor(T × p / 100), the no when R > sides − floor((sides − T) × p / 100).

levels.description: The likelihoods a question can be asked with; unique keys.

chaos.description: Absent when the oracle has no chaos factor.

exceptionalPercent.description: Size of the exceptional bands, in percent; 0 by default.

randomEvent.description: Absent when a double is no random event. Needs chaos and 100 sides.

likelihood.description: The key of the likelihood level to ask with.

chaosFactor.description: Within the oracle's chaos range; the neutral one when absent. Only allowed when the oracle has chaos.

answer.description: Yes when the roll is at most the effective target, no otherwise; exceptional within the oracle's exceptional bands.

effectiveTarget.description: The level's target shifted by the chaos factor and clamped to 0…sides.

likelihood.description: The key of the likelihood level asked with.

chaosFactor.description: The chaos factor used (the neutral one when none was given); null when the oracle has no chaos.

randomEvent.description: The key of the oracle table to roll when the roll is a double whose digit is at most the chaos factor used and the oracle has a random event rule; null otherwise.

OracleTableEntryDefinition.description: Ranged entries have "min" and "max"; weighted entries may have a "weight" (1 by default). An entry needs a "text" unless it nests a "table".

min.description: Lowest total this entry covers, on a ranged table.

max.description: Highest total this entry covers, on a ranged table.

weight.description: Relative chance of this entry, on a weighted table; 1 by default.

table.description: The key of a table of the set to roll on next when this entry is selected.

OracleTableDefinition.description: A ranged table has "dice" and entries with "min" and "max" that do not overlap; a weighted table has no "dice", entries with an optional "weight" and rolls 1dW for total weight W.

key.description: Unique within the table set: a-z, 0-9 and "-".

dice.description: Dice notation rolled on a ranged table; absent on a weighted table.

tables.description: The table set: unique keys; nested tables must be in the set, never cycle and nest at most 10 levels deep.

table.description: The key of the table to roll on.

dice.description: The normalized notation rolled: the table's dice, or "1dW" for a weighted table of total weight W.

total.description: The total rolled, which selected the entry.

text.description: The selected entry's text; may be empty when the entry nests a table.

nestedTableKey.description: The table the next step rolls on; null on the last step.

table.description: The key of the table rolled on first.

steps.description: One step per table rolled, root first; a step with a nestedTableKey is followed by the roll on that table.

expression.description: Dice notation: NdM, "d%", keep/drop selectors (kh, kl, dh, dl, k), integers, + - * / and parentheses. Case-insensitive; whitespace ignored.

value.description: The face the die landed on.

kept.description: Whether the die counts towards the total; false when a selector dropped it.

dice.description: Every die rolled, in roll order, dropped ones included.

subtotal.description: The sum of the kept dice.

expression.description: The normalized notation: lower case, no whitespace, "d" as "1d", "d%" as "d100", "k" as "kh".

total.description: The value of the expression, counting kept dice only.

groups.description: Every dice group, in notation order; empty when the expression rolls no dice.

database.description: Whether the database answers right now.
